name: Menu Grid Gallery
description: Full-screen editorial menu of large italic titles. Selecting a title swaps a scattered grid of tilted photo prints behind it, and Explore opens a full-page detail view with a captioned photo grid.
contents: Menu rows with plate number, big title and Explore link
Background grid of six rotated photo prints per item
Detail page per item with eyebrow, title, intro, date, back link and captioned photo grid
behavior: Clicking a row slides titles and flings prints up or down to the chosen item's set via GSAP
Explore opens a fixed overlay detail page and tints the page body with the item's color
Back returns to the menu and restores the ink color
Custom cursor follows the mouse with easing and grows over rows, only on fine pointers
Layout stacks to 2 columns and hides plate numbers at 640px and below
editableByProps: Number of items, titles, intros, dates, detail page colors, images and captions
Menu, Explore, back and eyebrow labels

needsCodeEdit.change: Change print positions in the background grid

needsCodeEdit.where: mgg-fonts link effect and --mgg-display, --mgg-body, --mgg-mono in STYLE_TEXT

fixed: Changes the page body background while the detail page is open and resets it on unmount
Detail page is a fixed full-screen overlay
Loads Fraunces, Inter and IBM Plex Mono from Google Fonts
Each item needs 6 images and 9 gallery images, and exactly the sample structure
Root has a minimum height of 100vh
